notes.scope: The current nine-item Fire Offering pool. Older Flames are historical context only.
notes.imagePolicy: Text-first because checked guides do not provide a clean distinct icon set for every current offering.

item.name: Coinsplosion Offering
item.effect: Spawns coins near the campfire and increases coin spawns across the map.
item.bestFor: Building coin income early in a run.
item.activation: Spend it through the Supply Crate inventory to apply its modifier to the current run.
item.activationLimit: One active Fire Modifier or Offering at a time.
item.cardSummary: An economy modifier that adds coins near camp and improves coin spawns across the map.

item.name: Fairy Offering
item.effect: Applies Fairy Seed effects across the map.
item.activation: Spend it through the Supply Crate inventory to apply its modifier to the current run.
item.activationLimit: One active Fire Modifier or Offering at a time.
item.cardSummary: A map-wide Fairy Seed modifier for runs built around plant and seed effects.

item.name: Red Chest Offering
item.effect: Increases the spawn rate of Red Chests.
item.bestFor: Targeting Red Chest loot during a prepared run.
item.activation: Spend it through the Supply Crate inventory to apply its modifier to the current run.
item.activationLimit: One active Fire Modifier or Offering at a time.
item.cardSummary: A targeted loot modifier that makes Red Chest spawns more common.

item.name: Apple Tree Offering

item.name: Fishing Offering

item.name: Blue Offering

item.activation: Spend it through the Supply Crate inventory to apply its modifier to the current run.

item.cardSummary: A survival modifier that protects campfire fuel from heavy rain drain.
